params.body:
The collage strip on the prelaunch screen was still in full colour. It gets the treatment the home page hero has since #120 and #121: black and white, with the round spot of colour drifting over it at rest and following the pointer. Same css (`.hero-reveal`), same script (`hero-reveal.js`); the component just carries the second layer now.

276 tests, Pint and the Tailwind lint clean.
params.title: The prelaunch strip gets the same drifting spot of colour
